assertions.text: Output asks the user for the repository name (AskUserQuestion) and does not infer it from the checkout, directory or git remote
Output plans to add the repository's option to the adopted organization-level databases' `repo` select as a schema change listed in the plan and approved with it
Output names notion-update-data-source (not notion-create-database) for that schema change
Output adopts the existing databases by stable ID instead of recreating them
Output records notion.repo through the local override (.claude/workmanagement-kit.local.json), not by editing the shipped versioned-configuration.json
Output requires plan-level approval before any change
Output's preview shows the exact ALTER statement that will be sent and the option list before and after
Output re-reads the data source immediately before the ALTER statement, sends a strict superset of the options that read shows, and plans to confirm every option ID is still present afterwards
Every tool this skill itself plans to call is within its allowed-tools
